fact_rationales.F12: Low hemoglobin indicates anemia, which can be seen in both leukemia and lymphoma, but in the context of other findings like high blast count, it supports B2.1 more.
fact_rationales.F14: High leukocyte count with 35% blasts is more typical of acute leukemia, such as Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (B2.1), than lymphoma.
